title: JobStatus
description: A point-in-time view of a submitted run job, returned by GET /runs/{job}. `404` for an unknown job id.

id.description: The job id (the same id POST /runs returned).

state.description: Where the job is in its lifecycle. `running` covers the whole up-to-an-hour run (seeding, the harness session, validation). `succeeded` means the run produced a record — the record's own `status.state` distinguishes a completed run from one classified as failed/unevaluable. `failed` means the run could not be driven to a record at all (the definition would not resolve, the container would not start, the harness was unavailable, the runtime cap fired).

record.description: The produced run record. Present only once `state` is `succeeded`; omitted otherwise.

detail.description: A human-readable failure reason. Present only when `state` is `failed`; omitted otherwise.
